name: Minecraft (ServerTap / RCON & Keystroke)
description: Integrasi Minecraft via ServerTap / RCON Command maupun Keystroke (Drop Item / Lompat)

mc_creeper.label: Spawn Creeper
mc_creeper.description: Munculkan Creeper dengan nama penonton di dekat player

mc_tnt.label: Spawn Primed TNT
mc_tnt.description: Jatuhkan TNT aktif di atas kepala player (Fuse 60 tick)

mc_zombie_horde.label: Zombie Horde (3x)
mc_zombie_horde.description: Munculkan 3 Zombie sekaligus di sekitar player
mc_zombie_horde.command: execute at {player} run summon zombie ~1 ~ ~; execute at {player} run summon zombie ~-1 ~ ~; execute at {player} run summon zombie ~ ~ ~1

mc_drop_hand.label: Drop Item di Tangan (Keystroke Q)
mc_drop_hand.description: Tekan tombol Q untuk membuang item yang sedang dipegang
